title: Regions where Zero Trust Gateways are supported (AWS and GCP)

prose.label: AWS.
prose.text: {{aws-list}} Whether `eu-central-2` belongs on it is a source conflict {{gap:eu-central-2}}.

checks.do: Whether the region code appears in the AWS or GCP list; if not, the help page directs the request to Zscaler Support.

scope.statement: The supported-regions article is scoped to Zscaler Zero Trust Gateways and has two tables, Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud Platform.

no-sovereign.statement: Neither list contains an AWS GovCloud or AWS China region, or any region beyond those listed, so a Zero Trust Gateway in such a region is not documented as supported.
no-sovereign.conditions: Follows from the complete tables; omission is not a statement that the region is refused, and the article directs such requests to Support.

eu-central-2.title: Whether eu-central-2 is a supported AWS Zero Trust Gateway region
eu-central-2.detail: Unverified legacy statement: the December 15, 2025 entry of the 2025 Release Upgrade Summary announced `eu-central-2` for Zero Trust Gateways alongside `sa-east-1`, `ca-central-1` and `eu-west-3`. The current capture of that release summary holds only its introduction, so the entry cannot be quoted, and the current regions table omits `eu-central-2` while listing the other three. Omission alone is not evidence of withdrawal.
eu-central-2.blocks: answering whether a gateway can be created in eu-central-2
